defmodule CryptoVault.KeyImporter do
  @moduledoc """
  Imports encrypted key bundles for the CryptoVault HSM proxy.
  Key bundles are zlib-compressed, then AES-256-GCM encrypted.
  Used by the Kubernetes operator to rotate signing keys.
  """

  require Logger

  @max_encrypted_payload_bytes 10 * 1024 * 1024  # 10 MB encrypted limit
  @max_keys_per_bundle 256
  @aes_key_length 32
  @aes_iv_length 12
  @aes_tag_length 16
  @absolute_max_decompressed 50 * 1024 * 1024  # 50 MB hard cap

  defmodule KeyBundle do
    defstruct [:keys, :metadata, :imported_at]
  end

  @doc """
  Imports a key bundle from the given binary payload.
  The payload format is: IV (12 bytes) || Tag (16 bytes) || Ciphertext
  After decryption, the plaintext is zlib-decompressed to recover CBOR-encoded keys.
  """
  def import_bundle(encrypted_payload, master_key, opts \\ []) do
    with :ok <- validate_encrypted_size(encrypted_payload),
         {:ok, plaintext} <- decrypt_payload(encrypted_payload, master_key),
         {:ok, decompressed} <- safe_decompress(plaintext, opts),
         {:ok, keys} <- parse_key_bundle(decompressed) do
      {:ok, %KeyBundle{keys: keys, metadata: %{count: length(keys)}, imported_at: DateTime.utc_now()}}
    end
  end

  defp validate_encrypted_size(payload) when byte_size(payload) <= @max_encrypted_payload_bytes, do: :ok
  defp validate_encrypted_size(_), do: {:error, :payload_too_large}

  defp decrypt_payload(payload, master_key) when byte_size(master_key) == @aes_key_length do
    <<iv::binary-size(@aes_iv_length), tag::binary-size(@aes_tag_length), ciphertext::binary>> = payload

    case :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(:aes_256_gcm, master_key, iv, ciphertext, <<>>, tag, false) do
      :error -> {:error, :decryption_failed}
      plaintext -> {:ok, plaintext}
    end
  end

  defp decrypt_payload(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_master_key}

  @doc """
  Decompresses zlib data with resource limits.
  Uses a streaming approach to enforce decompression ratio limits.
  """
  defp safe_decompress(compressed_data, opts) do
    max_decompressed = Keyword.get(opts, :max_decompressed_bytes, @absolute_max_decompressed)
    max_ratio = Keyword.get(opts, :max_ratio, 10)

    z = :zlib.open()
    :zlib.inflateInit(z)

    try do
      stream_inflate(z, compressed_data, 0, max_decompressed, max_ratio, byte_size(compressed_data), [])
    after
      :zlib.close(z)
    end
  end

  defp stream_inflate(z, data, total_out, max_bytes, max_ratio, compressed_size, acc) do
    chunk_size = 65_536
    chunks = for <<chunk::binary-size(chunk_size) <- data>>, do: chunk
    remainder_size = rem(byte_size(data), chunk_size)
    chunks = if remainder_size > 0 do
      chunks ++ [binary_part(data, byte_size(data) - remainder_size, remainder_size)]
    else
      chunks
    end

    do_inflate_chunks(z, chunks, total_out, max_bytes, max_ratio, compressed_size, acc)
  end

  defp do_inflate_chunks(_z, [], total_out, _max_bytes, _max_ratio, _compressed_size, acc) do
    {:ok, IO.iodata_to_binary(Enum.reverse(acc))}
  end

  defp do_inflate_chunks(z, [chunk | rest], total_out, max_bytes, max_ratio, compressed_size, acc) do
    case :zlib.safeInflate(z, chunk) do
      {:continue, decompressed_chunks} ->
        new_bytes = IO.iodata_length(decompressed_chunks)
        new_total = total_out + new_bytes
        current_ratio = if compressed_size > 0, do: div(new_total, compressed_size), else: 0

        if new_total >= max_bytes or current_ratio >= max_ratio do
          {:error, :decompression_bomb_detected}
        else
          do_inflate_chunks(z, rest, new_total, max_bytes, max_ratio, compressed_size, acc ++ decompressed_chunks)
        end

      {:finished, decompressed_chunks} ->
        new_bytes = IO.iodata_length(decompressed_chunks)
        new_total = total_out + new_bytes
        current_ratio = if compressed_size > 0, do: div(new_total, compressed_size), else: 0

        if new_total >= max_bytes or current_ratio >= max_ratio do
          {:error, :decompression_bomb_detected}
        else
          {:ok, IO.iodata_to_binary(Enum.reverse(acc ++ decompressed_chunks))}
        end

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:inflate_error, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp parse_key_bundle(decompressed) do
    # Simplified CBOR-like parsing for key material
    case :erlang.binary_to_term(decompressed, [:safe]) do
      keys when is_list(keys) and length(keys) <= @max_keys_per_bundle ->
        validated = Enum.filter(keys, &valid_key_entry?/1)
        {:ok, validated}
      _ ->
        {:error, :invalid_bundle_format}
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:error, :parse_error}
  end

  defp valid_key_entry?(%{id: id, algorithm: alg, material: mat})
    when is_binary(id) and is_atom(alg) and is_binary(mat) do
    byte_size(mat) in [16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 66]
  end
  defp valid_key_entry?(_), do: false
end
